summary: をきっかけに(して) / がきっかけで marks an event as the trigger or occasion that set off a change, a new habit, or a development — 'taking X as the trigger, ever since X'. It is neutral about whether the result is good or bad, and belongs to everyday as well as written Japanese.
structure: Noun ＋ をきっかけに（して）
pitfalls: がきっかけで foregrounds X as the cause, while をきっかけに frames X as something taken up as a starting point.
It marks the trigger of a change; the following clause should describe the new development that resulted.

examples.ja: 入院をきっかけに、彼は食生活を見直すようになった。
examples.en: His hospital stay was the trigger for him to start rethinking his diet.
examples.f: ｜入院[にゅういん]をきっかけに、｜彼[かれ]は｜食生活[しょくせいかつ]を｜見直[みなお]すようになった。

examples.ja: ある本との出会いがきっかけで、彼女は作家を目指し始めた。
examples.en: An encounter with a certain book was the trigger, and she began aiming to become a writer.
examples.f: ある｜本[ほん]との｜出会[であ]いがきっかけで、｜彼女[かのじょ]は｜作家[さっか]を｜目指[めざ]し｜始[はじ]めた。

synonyms.note: を契機に is the more formal, written near-synonym; をきっかけに suits everyday triggers and small changes too.

title: を契機に
meaning: as a turning point; taking ... as the opportunity
summary: を契機に(して) / を契機として marks an event as the turning point or catalyst that prompts a significant change or new direction — 'taking X as the occasion, using X as a turning point'. It is formal and written, and tends to accompany weighty, large-scale developments.
pitfalls: It is formal and written; for small everyday triggers, をきっかけに sounds more natural.
It usually introduces notable, large changes (reforms, life decisions) rather than trivial shifts.

examples.ja: 定年退職を契機に、彼は長年の夢だった世界一周の旅に出た。
examples.en: Taking his retirement as a turning point, he set off on the round-the-world journey he had long dreamed of.
examples.f: ｜定年[ていねん]｜退職[たいしょく]を｜契機[けいき]に、｜彼[かれ]は｜長年の夢[ながねんのゆめ]だった｜世界[せかい]｜一周[いっしゅう]の｜旅[たび]に｜出[で]た。

examples.ja: この事故を契機として、会社は安全管理を全面的に見直した。
examples.en: Prompted by this accident, the company thoroughly overhauled its safety management.
examples.f: この｜事故[じこ]を｜契機[けいき]として、｜会社[かいしゃ]は｜安全[あんぜん]｜管理[かんり]を｜全面[ぜんめん]｜的[てき]に｜見直[みなお]した。

synonyms.note: をきっかけに carries the same 'trigger' sense but is more everyday; を契機に is heavier and more formal.

title: を問わず
meaning: regardless of; irrespective of
summary: を問わず attaches to a noun to say something applies without regard to that factor — 'regardless of, irrespective of'. It typically follows a noun naming a variable (年齢, 経験) or a pair of opposites (男女, 昼夜), and the statement then holds true across all of them. It is formal in tone.
pitfalls: It takes a noun (a category, variable, or pair of opposites), not a clause or a か-question.
It is formal and written; にかかわらず is broader in what it can attach to and slightly less formal.

examples.ja: この仕事は経験を問わず、やる気のある人を歓迎します。
examples.en: This job welcomes motivated people regardless of experience.
examples.f: この｜仕事[しごと]は｜経験[けいけん]を｜問[と]わず、やる｜気[き]のある｜人[ひと]を｜歓迎[かんげい]します。

examples.ja: そのカフェは、季節を問わず多くの観光客でにぎわっている。
examples.en: That cafe bustles with tourists regardless of the season.
examples.f: そのカフェは、｜季節[きせつ]を｜問[と]わず｜多[おお]くの｜観光[かんこう]｜客[きゃく]でにぎわっている。

synonyms.note: にかかわらず also means 'regardless of' but attaches more freely, including to plain forms and か-questions.
いかんにかかわらず means 'regardless of what X is'; it is more formal and rigid than を問わず.

title: を除いて
meaning: except for; excluding; apart from
summary: を除いて / を除き sets one item aside from an otherwise general statement — 'except for, excluding, apart from'. What follows is presented as true for everything but the excepted thing: 日曜を除いて毎日 = 'every day except Sunday'.
pitfalls: を除き is the more formal, written form of を除いて.
It carves out a specific exception from a general claim; compare 以外, which is a more neutral, everyday 'other than'.

examples.ja: 日曜を除いて、この図書館は毎日利用できます。
examples.en: This library can be used every day except Sunday.
examples.f: ｜日曜[にちよう]を｜除[のぞ]いて、この｜図書館[としょかん]は｜毎日[まいにち]｜利用[りよう]できます。

examples.ja: 一部の地域を除き、明日は全国的に晴れるでしょう。
examples.en: Except for some areas, it will be sunny nationwide tomorrow.
examples.f: ｜一部[いちぶ]の｜地域[ちいき]を｜除[のぞ]き、｜明日[あした]は｜全国[ぜんこく]｜的[てき]に｜晴[は]れるでしょう。

synonyms.note: 以外 ('other than') is the everyday, neutral counterpart; を除いて more explicitly frames an item as an exception being removed.

title: をめぐって
meaning: concerning; over (a matter of dispute)
summary: をめぐって / をめぐる marks the central issue that people argue, debate, compete, or hold conflicting views about — 'over, concerning, surrounding'. It typically introduces a matter of contention involving several parties. Use をめぐる when modifying a following noun (をめぐる議論).
pitfalls: It implies multiple parties in disagreement or discussion around the topic, unlike the neutral 'about' of について.
Before a noun, switch to the form をめぐる: をめぐる論争, not をめぐって論争.

examples.ja: その土地の所有権をめぐって、二つの家族が長く争ってきた。
examples.en: Two families have long been in dispute over the ownership of that land.
examples.f: その｜土地[とち]の｜所有[しょゆう]｜権[けん]をめぐって、｜二[ふた]つの｜家族[かぞく]が｜長[なが]く｜争[あらそ]ってきた。

examples.ja: 新しい法案をめぐる議論が、国会で続いている。
examples.en: Debate over the new bill continues in the Diet.
examples.f: ｜新[あたら]しい｜法案[ほうあん]をめぐる｜議論[ぎろん]が、｜国会[こっかい]で｜続[つづ]いている。

synonyms.note: について is a neutral 'about / concerning' with no conflict implied; をめぐって suggests contention among parties.

related.note: において marks a domain or setting ('in, regarding'); をめぐって marks the specific issue people are at odds over.

title: をもとに
meaning: based on; on the basis of; drawing on
summary: をもとに(して) / をもとにした marks the material, source, or reference used to create or judge something — 'based on, drawing on'. The following action builds on that source as its foundation: 事件をもとに作った映画 = 'a film made based on the incident'. Use をもとにした before a noun.
structure: Noun ＋ をもとにした ＋ Noun
pitfalls: The source is raw material you build or judge from (data, a story, experience), so the following clause is usually one of creating or evaluating.
Compare に基づいて, which stresses conforming to a rule or principle; をもとに stresses using something as source material.

examples.ja: この映画は、実際に起きた事件をもとに作られたそうだ。
examples.en: This film was apparently made based on an incident that really happened.
examples.f: この｜映画[えいが]は、｜実際[じっさい]に｜起[お]きた｜事件[じけん]をもとに｜作[つく]られたそうだ。

examples.ja: アンケートの結果をもとに、新商品の改良を進めた。
examples.en: Drawing on the survey results, we went ahead with improvements to the new product.
examples.f: アンケートの｜結果[けっか]をもとに、｜新[しん]｜商品[しょうひん]の｜改良[かいりょう]を｜進[すす]めた。

synonyms.note: に基づいて also means 'based on', but emphasizes acting in accordance with a rule or principle rather than using source material.
